Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(g):

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r), key=lambda c:sum(r.count(c) for r in g))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # enumerate 2x2 blocks with exactly 3 same-colored cells
    seen=set()
    for i in range(H-1):

            vals=[g[i][j],g[i][j+1],g[i+1][j],g[i+1][j+1]]
            nz=[v for v in vals if v!=bg]
            if len(nz)==3 and len(set(nz))==1:
                c=nz[0]
                mi,mj=i+(0 if vals[0]!=c else 1)+((1 if vals[1]==c else 0)) , 0
                # missing corner
                miss=[(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]
                idx=[k for k,v in enumerate(vals) if v==bg][0]
                mi,i2=mi,i2 if False else 0,0
                mk=((idx//2), idx%2)
                # shape centroid
                cs=[(p,q) for p,q in [(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)] if vals[p*2+q]==c]
                cr=sum(p for p,q in cs)/3; cc=sum(q for p,q in cs)/3
                mr,mc=i+mk[0],j+mk[1]
                dr=int(-round(cr-mr)); dc=int(-round(cc-mc))
                dr=max(1 if dr>0 else -1, -1,0)
                # normalize diagonal sign
                dr=(1 if cr<mr else -1); dc=(1 if cc<mc else -1)
                r,c0=mr+dr, mc+dc
                while 0<=r<H and 0<=c0<W:

                    out[r][c0]=c
                    r+=dr; c0+=dc
    return out

for i in range(len(T)-1):
    for j in range(len(T[0])-1):
        vals=[T[i][j],T[i][j+1],T[i+1][j],T[i+1][j+1]]
        if vals.count(7)!=1: continue
        k=vals.index(7); c=next(v for v in vals if v!=7)
        mk=(k//2,k%2)
        cs=[(p,q) for p,q in [(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)] if vals[p*2+q]==c]
        cr=sum(p for p,q in cs)/3; cc=sum(q for p,q in cs)/3
        mr,mc=i+mk[0],j+mk[1]
        dr=(1 if cr<mr else -1); dc=(1 if cc<mc else -1)
        print((i,j),c,'misscorner',mk,'dir',(dr,dc),'mr,mc',(mr,mc))
